notices.summary: Ambrose Channel Lighted Buoy 5 is off station and Lighted Gong Buoy 13 is missing/troubled.
Preventive maintenance will occur at the Verrazzano Narrows Bridge from April 1, 2025, to May 6, 2026, with a traveler platform reducing vertical clearance.
A sailing regatta will occur every Wednesday evening from April 29 to September 16, 2026, between Morris Canal and Robbins Reef.
Shoaling has been reported in the vicinity of Great Kills Harbor, between buoys 6 and 8; proceed with caution.
Dredging operations and wharf construction will occur in Kill Van Kull from October 2, 2024, to January 29, 2029; use extreme caution.
Structural repairs to the Brooklyn Bridge will reduce vertical clearance by 17 feet through at least June 30, 2026; contact the contractor for full clearance.
Marine construction for the Hudson Tunnel Project will occur from January 6, 2026, to January 21, 2027; transit at slowest safe speed and maintain distance from structures.
